title: Enterprise Lab: High Availability Design
objectives: Design HA with redundant paths and devices.
scenario: Design a scalable network architecture with redundancy and high availability

errors.solution: Reduce hello/dead timers and use tracking.
Increase hold timers, verify tracking stability.
Verify both ends: mode active, same speed/duplex, trunk config.
Adjust weighting on AVFs for desired distribution.

questions.question: HSRP preempt purpose?
questions.solution: Allows preferred router to become active when available.

questions.question: GLBP vs HSRP difference?
questions.solution: GLBP = active-active load balancing (multiple AVFs). HSRP = active-standby.

questions.question: LACP vs PAgP?
questions.solution: LACP = IEEE standard. PAgP = Cisco proprietary.

steps.title: Analyze HA Requirements and Topology
steps.instruction: Review the topology and identify redundant paths, gateway redundancy requirements, and failover criteria.
steps.expectedOutput: Topology documented with redundant paths identified

commonErrors.solution: Verify physical connections between distribution switches

steps.title: Configure HSRP on Distribution Layer Switches
steps.instruction: Configure HSRP group 10 on Switch0 and Switch1 VLAN 10 interfaces for gateway redundancy with preempt and tracking.
steps.expectedOutput: HSRP group 10 configured with virtual IP 192.168.10.1

commonErrors.solution: Verify interface up, same HSRP group, matching virtual IP

hints: Preempt allows preferred to retake active

steps.title: Configure HSRP on Second Distribution Switch
steps.instruction: Configure HSRP group 10 on the second distribution switch with lower priority for standby role.
steps.expectedOutput: HSRP group 10 on second switch with priority 100

commonErrors.solution: Verify same HSRP group number and virtual IP

steps.title: Configure Object Tracking for Uplink Failure
steps.instruction: Configure track object 10 to monitor WAN uplink interface and decrement HSRP priority on failure.
steps.expectedOutput: Track object 10 monitoring Gi0/1, HSRP priority decrement on failure

commonErrors.solution: Verify tracked interface line-protocol state changes

steps.challenge: Add IP SLA tracking for end-to-end reachability

steps.title: Configure Second HSRP Group for Load Balancing
steps.instruction: Configure HSRP group 20 on VLAN 20 with opposite priorities for load balancing across uplinks.
steps.expectedOutput: HSRP group 20 configured with opposite priority for load balancing

commonErrors.solution: Verify opposite priorities for active/standby distribution

steps.title: Configure GLBP for Gateway Load Balancing
steps.instruction: Configure GLBP group 10 on VLAN 10 for active-active gateway load balancing with weighted distribution.
steps.expectedOutput: GLBP group 10 configured with weighted load balancing

commonErrors.solution: Verify both switches have glbp configured with weighting

steps.title: Configure Second Switch GLBP for Redundancy
steps.instruction: Configure GLBP group 10 on second switch with lower priority for gateway redundancy.
steps.expectedOutput: GLBP group 10 on second switch with priority 100

commonErrors.solution: Verify same virtual IP and group number on both switches

steps.title: Configure Dual-Homed Server NIC Teaming
steps.instruction: Configure server-facing access switch ports for NIC teaming (LACP) to dual-homed servers.
steps.expectedOutput: LACP Port-channel 10 created for server NIC teaming

commonErrors.solution: Verify both ends configured with mode active

steps.title: Configure Fast Failover Timers
steps.instruction: Tune HSRP/GLBP timers for sub-second failover detection and recovery.
steps.expectedOutput: HSRP/GLBP timers set to 200ms hello / 600ms hold for sub-second failover

commonErrors.solution: Increase hold timer if network unstable

steps.title: Configure Redundant Switch Uplinks with EtherChannel
steps.instruction: Bundle redundant uplinks between access and distribution switches using LACP EtherChannel.
steps.expectedOutput: LACP Port-channel 20 trunk formed between access and distribution

commonErrors.solution: Verify both ends: mode active, same speed/duplex, trunk config

steps.title: Verify HA Failover Behavior
steps.instruction: Test HSRP/GLBP failover by shutting primary uplink and verifying sub-second failover.
steps.expectedOutput: HSRP/GLBP failover verified with standby becoming active within timer thresholds

commonErrors.solution: Verify msec timers configured and tracking operational

steps.title: Final HA Configuration Verification and Documentation
steps.instruction: Run comprehensive HA verification, document all redundancy configurations, and save.
steps.expectedOutput: Complete HA configuration documented, all redundancy verified, config saved
steps.challenge: Export HA config to documentation repository

topology:
Switch0 (Dist) <-> Switch1 (Dist) dual uplink
Switch0 -> Access1, Access2
Switch1 -> Access1, Access2
Access -> Servers (dual-homed)
prerequisites: Advanced switching, HSRP/GLBP, EtherChannel, LACP knowledge
